gate_ledger.title: SIGNula as IdP — SAML/OIDC provider + OAuth2 authorization server
gate_ledger.reason: Large architectural epic; biggest single capability gap. Build multi-cycle on tested base; security-reviewed per stage (token signing, JWKS, key rotation, client registration, consent).

gate_ledger.title: Recurring billing / subscription lifecycle engine (#67)
gate_ledger.reason: Payment-touching -> build in TEST MODE only; live-payment credential wiring (#70) stays operational/user (Bucket-3, never autonomous). Engine scaffolded (BillingScheduler). B-007 placeholder redirects fixed here.

gate_ledger.reason: Security-critical auth path + vendored JWT lib (self-hosted, no Composer in prod). Shares token-signing/JWKS foundation with G-001; build after auth safety-net.
